description: Data layer: migrations for all 7 content tables + models/relationships + seeders reproducing the EXACT js/data.js values (design B.4, B.5, B.14). Depends on FEAT-001 (Laravel scaffold + .env). After this feature `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` builds the schema and loads all seed data in one command (AC #7, #9).
steps: Create migrations exactly per design B.4: cars (model, type, category, year smallint, price bigint, transmission, fuel, seats tinyint, badge nullable, accent1/accent2 char(7), img varchar(500) NOT NULL, sort_order int default 0); category_styles (category varchar(20) UNIQUE, bg char(7), label); quiz_questions (question, icon, sort_order); quiz_options (quiz_question_id FK cascade, text, icon, sort_order); quiz_option_scores (quiz_option_id FK cascade, car_model varchar(100), points tinyint); wheel_prizes (label, short, color char(7), weight int, msg, sort_order); corner_images (src varchar(500) NOT NULL, alt, sort_order); hero_slides (name, description, tag, price string, img varchar(500) NOT NULL, sort_order); testimonials (name, city, car, rating tinyint, color char(7), img varchar(500) NOT NULL, text, sort_order). Keep Breeze's default users/sessions/cache/jobs migrations. cars.img, hero_slides.img, testimonials.img, corner_images.src MUST be NOT NULL (design #2 fix).

Create models per design B.5 in app/Models: Car (fillable all columns; cast price/year/seats to int; `accent` accessor returning [accent1, accent2]); CategoryStyle (table category_styles); QuizQuestion (hasMany QuizOption ordered by sort_order); QuizOption (belongsTo QuizQuestion, hasMany QuizOptionScore); QuizOptionScore (belongsTo QuizOption); WheelPrize; CornerImage; HeroSlide; Testimonial.

Create seeders wired through DatabaseSeeder in this order (design B.14): AdminUserSeeder (admin@daihatsu.test, password via Hash::make('password')); CategoryStyleSeeder (LCGC/#2e86ff/Hemat, MPV/#0a5fd1/Keluarga, SUV/#123a8f/SUV, Niaga/#5b6a8c/Niaga); CarSeeder (9 rows id 1..9, accent split into accent1/accent2 copied VERBATIM from js/data.js incl. Sigra #ffc529/#f59e0b, empty badge -> NULL, sort_order = 0-based index); QuizSeeder (4 questions fa-bullseye/fa-users/fa-heart/fa-wallet, 14 options total Q1=4 Q2=3 Q3=4 Q4=3, each option's full score map from js/data.js written as quiz_option_scores rows, sort_order set on questions 0..3 and options 0-based within each question); WheelPrizeSeeder (6 rows, short with REAL \n newline, exact colors/weights/msgs, sort_order 0..5); CornerImageSeeder (img/halo.jpeg, img/bingung.jpeg, img/hubungi.jpeg + alts, sort_order 0..2); HeroSlideSeeder (4 rows Terios/Rocky/Xenia/Ayla, desc->description, display price, sort_order 0..3); TestimonialSeeder (6 rows exact, sort_order 0..5). Every seeder sets sort_order explicitly to the 0-based js/data.js index.

Read d:\DATA - AHMAD\Project\kuya\js\data.js directly and copy every value verbatim — do NOT re-derive from the brand palette. Enumerated car accent pairs and the full per-option quiz score maps are listed in design.md B.14 steps 3 and 4; cross-check against data.js.
acceptance_criteria: `php artisan migrate:fresh` completes with no errors and all 7 content tables + users exist.
`php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` completes with no errors.
Row counts (via the MySQL CLI) are exactly cars=9, category_styles=4, quiz_questions=4, quiz_options=14, wheel_prizes=6, corner_images=3, hero_slides=4, testimonials=6, users=1 (design AC #9).
quiz_option_scores contains every score pair from the 14 options' score maps.
A seeded wheel_prizes.short value contains a real newline character (round-trips to split('\n')).
A Car model instance exposes `accent` as a 2-element array.
verification: & "D:\DATA - AHMAD\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe" -u root -h 127.0.0.1 daihatsu_db -e "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars) cars,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category_styles) cat,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_questions) q,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_options) opt,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wheel_prizes) wp,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM corner_images) ci,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_slides) hs,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM testimonials) t,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) u;"
findings: Implemented 9 migrations (prefixed 2024_01_01_000001..000009, running after Breeze's 0001_01_01 users/cache/jobs), 9 models, 8 seeders + DatabaseSeeder. migrate:fresh --seed runs clean; verified row counts cars=9, category_styles=4, quiz_questions=4, quiz_options=14, quiz_option_scores=41, wheel_prizes=6, corner_images=3, hero_slides=4, testimonials=6, users=1. Final tables/columns match design B.4 exactly: cars(id,model,type,category,year,price,transmission,fuel,seats,badge nullable,accent1,accent2,img NOT NULL,sort_order), category_styles(category UNIQUE,bg,label), quiz_questions(question,icon,sort_order), quiz_options(quiz_question_id FK cascade,text,icon,sort_order), quiz_option_scores(quiz_option_id FK cascade,car_model,points), wheel_prizes(label,short,color,weight,msg,sort_order), corner_images(src NOT NULL,alt,sort_order), hero_slides(name,description,tag,price,img NOT NULL,sort_order), testimonials(name,city,car,rating,color,img NOT NULL,text,sort_order). Verified: Car::find(2)->accent === ['#ffc529','#f59e0b'] (2-element array via accessor); wheel_prizes.short round-trips to 2 lines via split on \n; Gran Max (id 6) and Terios (id 9) badge stored NULL. sort_order set to 0-based index on every seeder; cars seeded with explicit ids 1..9. Admin credentials: email admin@daihatsu.test, password 'password' (Hash::make, AdminUserSeeder uses updateOrCreate on email). Note: 'php artisan test --filter=Model' finds no tests yet — the Model/shape feature test belongs to a later test-authoring feature (design B.16), not FEAT-002; the data-layer ACs were verified directly via SQL counts and tinker.
